Lopburi's famous long-tailed macaque monkeys are thousands of urban-dwelling primates centered around the ancient Khmer temple of [Phra Prang Sam Yot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phra_Prang_Sam_Yot) in central Thailand, located about a three-hour drive north of Bangkok . While long treated as a cultural symbol and tourist attraction, the population grew out of control, leading authorities to launch major roundups, sterilizations, and containment programs to manage aggressive behavior and reclaim the city streets.[](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/05/no-more-monkey-business-thai-lopburi-macaques-to-be-rounded-up-and-put-in-enclosures) [[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/05/no-more-monkey-business-thai-lopburi-macaques-to-be-rounded-up-and-put-in-enclosures)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zfWt7vTfLQ)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lopburi)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c_tGz3qeRso&t=1)[[5]](https://www.reuters.com/investigates/special-report/thailand-monkeys-lopburi/)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=upoPEaEg9Eo&t=9)

Habitat and Behavior

- **Location:** Concentrated primarily around the Phra Prang Sam Yot temple and the Sarn Phra Karn shrine.
- **Urban Conflict:** Roving packs frequently damage property, steal food or accessories from visitors, and disrupt local businesses.
- **Management:** Wildlife officials conduct targeted feedings at 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM, alongside aggressive sterilization and relocation efforts to reduce population pressures.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zfWt7vTfLQ) 

Visitor Tips

- **Secure Valuables:** Remove or tightly hold glasses, jewelry, hats, and bags, as macaques readily snatch loose items.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zfWt7vTfLQ) [[1]](https://www.boundingoveroursteps.com/a-day-trip-to-lopburi-monkey-business/)[[2]](https://www.gintravels.com/2025/01/30/lop-buri-city-of-deceitful-monkeys-thailand/)
- **No Open Food:** Avoid carrying visible food or drinks unless feeding them in authorized, safe contexts, to prevent sudden aggressive lunges.[](https://www.boundingoveroursteps.com/a-day-trip-to-lopburi-monkey-business/) 
- **Watch for Warnings:** Pay attention to animal body language and respect local rules against unauthorized feeding, which can carry heavy fines.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zfWt7vTfLQ)

expanded_element.title: Phra Prang Sam Yot - Wikipedia
expanded_element.description: Monkeys. The temple is famous for its large population of crab-eating macaque monkeys, which live in and around the temple grounds. The monkey population has always been present in Lopburi, but the start of the locally-held Monkey Buffet Festival in 1989 led to a dramatic increase in their population.

expanded_element.title: Plan Your Trip to Lopburi Today - Thailand Starts Here
expanded_element.description: Lopburi, whether you go on a day trip (as most travelers do) or stay overnight (ideally, as part of a central Thailand road trip), is absolutely lovely. I appreciated it even more, in fact, in the context of an adventure that also saw me visiting Phetchabun, Ayutthaya and Ang Thong within the span of a few days.

items.title: Why did the monkey population explode in Lopburi?

expanded_element.title: In Thailand's Lopburi, macaques are intertwined with the city's history ...
expanded_element.description: Decades of feeding by locals and tourists taught the monkeys that humans meant food. With a steady supply of snacks, fruits, and sodas, their population exploded into the thousands.

items.title: Are the monkeys in Thailand friendly?

expanded_element.title: Monkeys in Thailand: Types, Where to See Them & Safety Tips
expanded_element.description: While you might feel tempted to get close and interact closely with monkeys, you must observe them from a safe distance. Although attacks are uncommon, certain monkeys may feel threatened if you get too close, and they will not shy away from biting or scratching.

items.title: What to do if bitten by a monkey in Thailand?

expanded_element.title: Monkey Bites Care: Dos and Don'ts | Bangkok Hospital Phuket
expanded_element.description: Contact the authorities : You should contact the authorities immediately if you are bitten by a monkey in a public or tourist area so that necessary actions can be taken. Symptoms of B virus infection: B virus infection in humans typically results from exposure to monkey secretions.

expanded_element.title: What to see in Lopburi? A historic town… with monkeys
expanded_element.description: With its rich historical past, the city boasts many ancient remains, and Lopburi is well worth a visit. The city remains an interesting stopover, about a three-hour drive from Bangkok.
